verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developers page says users can 'use our API directly to take full control of your workflow' and offers Zapier as an integration path. That supports some programmatic access, but the pack never shows the API documentation itself, and probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt. The missing spec does not contradict the API claim, so this is not disputed. Missing for 10: actual API reference documentation (endpoints, auth, capabilities), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence the API covers core actions (scan, forward, deposit), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
